menu_options.credentials: Sign in with email and password

token.title: Access token
token.description: Paste a Bearer token for your EP Cube account. Pick the region your account belongs to — an account exists on exactly one, and a token from the wrong one fails as though it had expired.

credentials.title: Sign in
credentials.description: The same email and password you use in the EP Cube app. Signing in solves a puzzle CAPTCHA, which occasionally needs a second attempt.

reauth_confirm.title: Access token expired
reauth_confirm.description: The token for your {region} account is no longer accepted. Paste a new one.

error.invalid_auth: Token rejected. It may have expired, or it may belong to a different region — check the region before replacing it.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EP Cube service.
error.captcha_failed: Could not complete sign-in. The puzzle CAPTCHA fails intermittently; try again.
error.no_device: That account has no system attached to it.

abort.already_configured: This system is already set up.

data.enable_statistics: Read monthly, yearly and lifetime totals

data_description.enable_series: The only source of a measured battery power reading. Without it, battery power is inferred from the other flows and carries some noise.
data_description.enable_statistics: Four extra requests per update. These totals change slowly, so leaving this off costs little.

token_expired.message: The EP Cube access token is no longer valid.

config_unavailable.message: The current device configuration could not be read, so it cannot be changed safely.

no_tou_schedule.message: No time-of-use periods are configured. Switching to that mode now would leave the battery on an empty tariff calendar.
